steps.content: You come back to your senses. When you turn back again, the door of Hella's cell is already broken. She collapses to the floor in agony.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Bastard... Bastard... I'll kill you as soon as I get the chance...
S-019 looks at you. The shadow next to her is now clear in your eyes. This is the real form of that horrible nightmare, which can no longer terrify you.

steps.speaker: S-019
steps.content: Any Sinners branded with <color=#fb9259>the shackles</color> are at your disposal.
As she speaks, she turns her gaze toward the other side of the corridor.
The rioters are here. The commotion here draws their attention, and they are now shouting and rushing over.

steps.speaker: S-019
steps.content: You are now an actual Chief. Please give me orders. From now on, I only follow your orders.
